About.title: Modern Building For Consultancy Engineering (MBCE)
About.subtitle: Established in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia with an uncompromising commitment to structural integrity, human safety, and regulatory excellence.
About.overviewP1: Modern Building For Consultancy Engineering (MBCE) is a premier KSA-based engineering consultancy specializing in Fire and Life Safety (FLS) system design, building code compliance, and Civil Defense approval services.
About.overviewP2: In full alignment with the Saudi Building Code (SBC 201/801), NFPA, IFC, and IBC standards, MBCE collaborates closely with private developers, public ministries, and regulatory bodies such as the General Directorate of Saudi Civil Defense, MODON, and the Royal Commission.
About.visionText: To stand as the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia's foremost Fire and Life Safety engineering consultancy, recognized for benchmark technical rigor, engineering innovation, and institutional trust.
About.missionText: To safeguard human life, national assets, and built infrastructure through unyielding adherence to codes, optimized value engineering, and seamless regulatory licensing.
About.chairmanMessage: Under the leadership of Chairman Eng. Anmar Al Qureshi and Executive Director Eng. Mohammad Almaayh, MBCE has spearheaded safety benchmarks for major developments across Riyadh, Jeddah, Makkah, and the Eastern Province.
About.codesSubtitle: Every blueprint, calculation, and hydraulic simulation engineered by MBCE complies rigorously with international and national safety mandates:

Services.title: Premier Fire & Life Safety Engineering Services
Services.subtitle: Authoritative engineering consultancy across the complete project lifecycle — from code reviews to final Civil Defense licensing.

fls.title: Fire & Life Safety (FLS) Engineering
fls.description: Comprehensive egress modeling, compartmentation analysis, fire hazard classification, and active/passive life safety system design in compliance with SBC and NFPA.

civilDefense.title: Civil Defense Approvals & Licensing
civilDefense.description: Accredited engineering representation and streamlined processing through the official Saudi Civil Defense Salamah portal for commercial, industrial, and high-rise structures.

buildingCode.title: Saudi Building Code (SBC) Compliance
buildingCode.description: Rigorous auditing against SBC 201 (General Building Requirements) and SBC 801 (Fire Code), identifying variances early to eliminate expensive rework.

valueEngineering.title: Value Engineering
valueEngineering.description: Strategic optimization of fire protection architecture and mechanical systems to minimize capital expenditure without compromising safety or regulatory compliance.

testingCommissioning.title: Testing & Commissioning
testingCommissioning.description: On-site performance verification, fire pump flow testing, integrated fire alarm cause-and-effect matrix validation, and final handover audits.

mep.title: Mechanical & Plumbing (MEP) Engineering
mep.description: Integrated mechanical engineering, cold and hot water supply networks, industrial drainage, and specialized hazard suppression infrastructure.
points: Fire water reservoir & pump room design
HVAC integration with life safety systems
